S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools.
representative_failures: A15/A16: Searched for cheapest ATL->PHL flights but selected wrong option (HAT110+HAT172 expected)
A21: Failed to identify fastest Houston->Denver return trip from search results
A42/A44: Could not reason over reservation data to find duplicates or compute flight durations
R3/R4: Failed to enumerate all t-shirt product variants from catalog
R28: Wrong items identified across multiple orders for return
R99: Selected wrong bicycle/camera exchange variants when matching constraints
S1.cognitive_note: Agent retrieves tool output but fails to cross-reference fields (e.g., price, duration, flight number) to satisfy multi-attribute selection criteria.

S2.label: Tool calling precision
representative_failures: A8: book_reservation called with wrong passengers or payment method
A17: update_reservation_baggages used credit_card instead of gift_card
R41/R42: modify_pending_order_address used wrong address fields
R60: modify_pending_order_items used wrong item_id for blue earbuds
R109-R112: address or item modification called with mismatched field values
S2.cognitive_note: Agent understands the intent and picks the correct tool but passes wrong argument values — typically wrong IDs, payment methods, or item attributes.

S3.label: Multi-step task completion
representative_failures: A18: Downgraded only 1 of 5 reservations and forgot to compute total savings
A22: Completely abandoned a 3-change transaction mid-way
A37: Upgraded instead of executing cancel+upgrade in correct sequence
R12: Completed return but forgot to also transfer to human for PayPal preference
R97: Updated item but forgot to also update shipping address
R104: Hit max_steps while handling parallel returns+modification task
S3.cognitive_note: Agent loses track of pending sub-goals across turns, especially when there are 3+ simultaneous requests or the conversation changes topic.

S4.label: Precondition verification
representative_failures: A26: Refunded a Basic Economy cancellation without verifying refund eligibility
A31: Modified a Basic Economy flight despite policy forbidding any modification
A47: Cancelled for 'birthday' reason without checking insurance only covers health/weather
A49: Cancelled for user claiming insurance without verifying insurance field on reservation
R51: Tried to return item from order that had not been delivered
R82/R83: Transferred to human instead of checking if exchange was feasible first
S4.cognitive_note: Agent executes state-changing actions before retrieving and checking the relevant policy conditions or eligibility flags. Highest frequency failure mode in airline domain.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
representative_failures: A12: Wrong total price difference calculated for cabin upgrade across passengers
A21: Selected wrong return flight because duration arithmetic was incorrect
A23: Payment distribution across three bookings did not sum correctly
A38: Issued $150 certificate when correct amount for 1-passenger basic economy with insurance is $50
R16: Failed to compute total refund $8276.23 across cancelled + returned orders
R44: Computed wrong price difference for desk lamp swap ($17.99 expected, got wrong value)
R59: calculate('164.28') for W8268610 refund not executed before cancellation
S5.cognitive_note: Agent makes arithmetic errors when computing aggregate totals, price differences, or when applying per-unit rates across multiple items/passengers.

S6.label: Record discovery and retrieval
representative_failures: A8: Looked at wrong prior reservation when replicating trip details
A25: Retrieved wrong reservation as 'current' when booking friend's copy
A49: Did not retrieve/check insurance field on reservation before accepting user claim
R5-R9: Failed to correctly look up user account via find_user_id_by_name_zip
R30: Retrieved wrong order for tracking number lookup
R67: Repeated find_user_id_by_name_zip failures with wrong zip attempts
S6.cognitive_note: Agent either queries the wrong identifier, fails to disambiguate among multiple records, or skips a lookup step needed to verify a user-supplied claim.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.description: Right action, fails to state values.
representative_failures: A11: Downgraded cabin correctly (DB match=True) but never communicated the $5244 refund amount
A14: Made correct booking but did not communicate that $44 would be charged to Mastercard
A18: Completed all 5 downgrades but did not communicate total savings of $23553
R19: Completed exchange but did not state savings amount of $41.64
R24: Cancelled order but failed to mention one of the t-shirts was polyester
R103: Returned items correctly (DB=True) but communicated wrong tracking number
S7.cognitive_note: Agent completes the mechanical action but forgets to narrate a specific numeric or categorical value that the evaluation requires to be verbally confirmed.

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.description: Ignores if-then or wrong API for state.
representative_failures: A7: Tried to upgrade Basic Economy before cancelling — wrong API for that state
A10: Upgraded cabin for only one flight leg, ignoring rule that all legs must match
A19: Tried to modify a Basic Economy flight instead of cancelling it
A26: Cancelled without checking that refund is only allowed under specific conditions
R10: Processed cross-payment returns directly instead of recognizing this requires human escalation
R36/R37: Did not recognize that split-payment is not supported; should have suggested cheapest item downgrade instead
R57: Cancelled whole order even though user's conditional chain required gift card refund as prerequisite
R90: Cancelled with wrong reason ('ordered by mistake') when correct condition was 10x zoom unavailability at price >$3000
S8.cognitive_note: Agent fails to evaluate if-then chains or ignores API/policy state transitions. It either applies the wrong tool for the current object state, or skips a conditional branch that changes which action is appropriate.
